title: Inventory Dwell Loss Radar
oneLiner: A used-car margin dashboard that ranks aging inventory by dwell risk, pricing drift, and carrying-cost pressure.
targetUser: Independent used-car dealers, lot managers, and automotive inventory operators.
keyUX: Rank aging vehicles by margin erosion, inspect one listing context, and choose a pricing or merchandising move before more carrying cost accumulates.
requiredUISections: per-vehicle pricing and inquiry trend panel
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop used-car inventory margin dashboard called Inventory Dwell Loss Radar for independent dealers and used-car lot operators. It should help teams find which vehicles are quietly destroying margin by combining dwell time, pricing drift, lead activity, carrying cost, and expected discount pressure into one action-oriented view. Include an inventory loss KPI hero, a dwell-risk queue, a per-vehicle pricing and inquiry trend panel, a financing cost comparison module, an action-priority drawer, and a recoverable margin rail. Design direction: use a financial control-room style with deep navy, slate neutrals, and sharp amber highlights; keep charts analytical, tables high-signal, and the product feel sober, margin-aware, and decisive.
